findings.where: Hero, the first screen at desktop and phone, and the whole page below it
findings.fault: The first screen has no way to reach Mark. It holds the name, the nav, the line, the paragraph and the portrait, and nothing else. The parts map has no mailto and no contact link anywhere on the page. The palette and texture notes describe a pad-yellow address strip at the foot of the sheet, but no address strip is drawn. On desktop the space it would use is the empty band between the header and the headline, and on phone it is below the paragraph inside the frame. Both are unused.
findings.who_objects: A development-bank officer who has decided to approach Mark finds no address or action to use and has to search elsewhere. The founder also objects: his personal-advisor test asks for one direct, personal way to reach Mark, and the brief asks for one action on the first screen with the address shown.

findings.where: Between the article specimen's Download item and the Motion panel (desktop-04 bottom into desktop-05; phone-03)
findings.fault: The Motion panel starts flush against the PDF line, with no space between them. Every other section has a generous gap above it. Here, proximity and the panel's common region make the download read as the top of the motion block, and the article seems to have no ending.
findings.who_objects: The founder, and anyone judging the article specimen. The reading page appears cut off, and the PDF list the research calls the product looks like part of the motion notes.

findings.where: Palette, the four swatches (desktop-02 and phone-01)
findings.fault: Each swatch has a different shape and edge: a square-cornered outlined box, a rounded slab, an ellipse, and a box with a heavy blue border. The swatches don't read as one row of like things. The difference in shape seems to mean something it doesn't, and the blue-ringed yellow box looks focused or selected.
findings.who_objects: The founder, who compares colours here. The odd shapes pull the eye to geometry instead of shade, and the unequal visual weight of the ellipse and the blue ring skews the comparison of the colours themselves.

findings.where: Article specimen, the Download row at desktop (desktop-04)
findings.fault: The PDF title is pinned left and its 'Lecture · 23 April 2026 · PDF' meta is pinned to the far right of the column, about 100 px away. The meta floats loose rather than reading as the title's details. On phone the two stack and group correctly.
findings.who_objects: A visitor scanning Mark's downloads. They have to bridge the gap to see what kind of file it is and how recent it is, and the list will look ragged once several items are added.
